---
title: "Installation"
description: "Steps to install zen-do to use on the command-line."
order: 0
---

Before installing zen-do, you need to have [Rust and
Cargo](https://rust-lang.org/tools/install/) installed. zen-do currently is only
available on the GitHub repository and needs to be built from the source files.
You can download the repository and build the package by running the following
command:

```bash {filename="Terminal"}
cargo install --git https://github.com/seedcase-project/zen-do
```

Cargo installs packages in different folders, depending on your operating
system:

*On MacOS or Linux:*

```bash {filename="Terminal"}
cd $HOME/.cargo/bin
```

*On Windows:*

```bash {filename="Terminal"}
cd %USERPROFILE%\.cargo\bin
```

::: callout-note
Since zen-do is not yet on [crates.io](https://crates.io), you also need to have
Git installed on your computer. When we officially release zen-do, you won't
need Git to install zen-do and will be able to install using the command:

```bash {filename="Terminal"}
cargo install seedcase-propagate
```
:::

To confirm that zen-do was installed correctly, run:

```bash {filename="Terminal"}
zen-do --version
```
